command.title: Command Palette
command.desc: Search for a command to execute...

already_exists.label: This comic already exists in your library.

integrity_violation.label: Integrity error: invalid or missing reference.

session_busy.label: A sync session is already in progress with this device.

timed_out.label: The sync took too long and was cancelled — the device may have gone offline.

empty.desc: Your library is empty right now. Perform a quick sync in the current folder or select another folder containing your comics (.cbz, .cbr, .pdf).

hide_confirm.title: Hide Comics
hide_confirm.desc: Are you sure you want to hide the selected comic(s)? They will be hidden from the library.

delete_confirm.title: Delete Comics
delete_confirm.desc: Are you sure you want to delete the selected comic(s)? This will permanently delete the folder and physical files from disk — this action cannot be undone.

clear_metadata_confirm.title: Clear Metadata
clear_metadata_confirm.desc: This deletes ComicInfo.xml, cover and banner from each of the {count} selected comic(s)' folder, plus all synced metadata in the database. Chapters and volumes are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

home.no_results_filtered: No comics found for the selected filter.

volume_highlight.title: Volume Highlight
volume_highlight.desc: Choose how volumes are highlighted: as covers or banners.

bookmark.title: Bookmark
bookmark.desc: Assign a bookmark to this comic.

external_sync.title: External Sync
external_sync.desc: Allow this comic to be automatically updated during batch syncs.

rescan.title: Sync local chapters
rescan.desc: Updates only the chapters that are new or changed in this folder.

deep_rescan.title: Rescan entire comic
deep_rescan.desc: Wipes the indexed chapters and volumes and rebuilds everything from the folder.

confirm.title: Rescan this comic from scratch?
confirm.desc: This wipes the indexed chapters and volumes for this comic and rebuilds them from the folder on disk. Reading history and bookmarks tied to removed chapters may be affected. This action cannot be undone.

p2p_sync.title: Sync with Device
p2p_sync.empty: No paired devices yet. Pair a device on the Network screen.

send.title: Send this comic
send.desc: Syncs only this comic with the chosen device, without touching the rest of the library.

regenerate.title: Use chapter page as cover
regenerate.desc: Extracts the first chapter's first page and sets it as the comic cover, replacing the current one.

regenerate_volumes.title: Generate volume covers
regenerate_volumes.desc: Extracts the first page of each volume's first chapter and sets it as that volume's cover, replacing the current ones.

clear_metadata.title: Clear metadata
clear_metadata.desc: Deletes ComicInfo.xml, the cover and the banner from the folder, and removes the synced metadata (title, description, authors, AniList/MangaDex) from the database. Useful for reverting a sync that pulled in wrong data.

confirm.title: Clear this comic's metadata?
confirm.desc: This deletes ComicInfo.xml, cover and banner from the folder on disk, plus all synced metadata in the database. Chapters and volumes are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

comic_info.title: ComicInfo.xml
comic_info.desc: Extract metadata from ComicInfo.xml in local folder

open_failed.title: Couldn't open this chapter
open_failed.desc: The pages may be corrupted, or the file may have been moved or deleted. Try again or go back.

sync.title: Sync history
sync.empty: No paired devices. Pair a device in Network to sync your history.

clear.title: Are you absolutely sure?
clear.desc: This action cannot be undone. All reading history will be permanently deleted.

comic_path.title: Comics folder
comic_path.desc: Folder where comics are searched and saved: {path}

comic_info.title: Generate ComicInfo.xml
comic_info.desc: Create metadata file in folder when syncing.

lang.title: Language
lang.desc: Select the default language for metadata.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.desc: Create custom bookmarks to categorize your comics.
bookmarks.name: Bookmark name

templates.title: Naming Templates
templates.desc: Patterns used to recognize chapter and volume numbers from file or folder names during scanning.

nav.title: Naming Templates
nav.desc: Create and manage the naming patterns used to auto-detect chapters and volumes.

help.title: How to build a template
help.desc: Combine fixed text (like "Ch." or "Vol.") with the macros below, always in curly braces. Use an asterisk to cover any variable part of the name, like the chapter title.
help.macro_chapter_desc: Required and unique in chapter templates.
help.macro_volume_desc: Required and unique in volume templates.
help.macro_decimal_desc: Optional. At most one per template, always after the chapter or volume.
help.macro_extension_desc: Required in chapter templates. Acerola appends it by itself at the end — you don't need to (or get to) type it.
help.wildcard_desc: Covers any text, like the chapter title or variable spacing.

form.title: Create new template
form.label: Template name
form.label_placeholder: A name to identify this template
form.extension_auto_hint: The file extension is already included automatically at the end of the pattern — no need to type it.

list.default_hint: Default templates ship with the app and cannot be edited or removed.

delete_confirm.title: Remove template?
delete_confirm.desc: The template "{label}" will be removed and will no longer be recognized when scanning the library.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Connect another Acerola device to bring your reading history and comics with you.
network.keyring_unavailable: Your system's secure keyring isn't available, so the encryption key protecting your device identity and trusted peers is stored in a local file instead — still encrypted, but without OS-level protection. This can happen on Linux without a keyring service (like gnome-keyring) running.

pairing.title: Connection code
pairing.desc: Scan this QR code on the other device, or copy the code below.
pairing.security_note: Only pair with devices you trust — the first connection permanently grants access to your library.
pairing.qr_error: Couldn't generate the QR code. Use the text code below instead.

connect.title: Connect to a device
connect.error: Couldn't connect. Make sure the code is correct and the other device has Acerola open.
connect.invalid_code: Invalid code. Make sure you copied the full code from the other device.

peers.title: Paired devices
peers.empty: No devices paired yet. Share your code or paste one above to pair.
peers.offline_hint: This device isn't reachable right now — reconnect it to sync.
peers.more_actions: More sync actions for this device.

remove_confirm.title: Remove "{peer}"?
remove_confirm.desc: This device loses access to your library. If it tries to connect again later, it'll go through the same confirmation as a never-paired device.

onboarding.welcome: Welcome to Acerola, your comic reader.

language.title: Select Language
language.desc: Choose your preferred language for the application.

formats.title: Supported Formats
formats.desc: Acerola supports the following reading formats:

cbz.title: Comic Book ZIP
cbz.desc: Random access ZIP container. Instant reading with smart in-memory caching and prefetching.

cbr.title: Comic Book RAR
cbr.desc: Native support via Unrar in Rust. On-demand page extraction directly into memory with zero temporary files.

pdf.title: PDF Document
pdf.desc: Automatically converted to CBZ via Pdfium engine in background for optimal reader performance.

sync_note.title: Automatic Sync:
sync_note.content: Acerola scans and indexes your files in these formats without needing manual extraction.

folder.title: Comics Folder
folder.desc: Select the folder where your comics are stored.

complete.title: All Set!
complete.desc: Your Acerola is ready to use.
complete.note: You can always change these settings later in the Settings page.
